title: S068 4.2.5 Reply Codes after DATA and the Subsequent <CRLF>.<CRLF>
parent_path: S068 4.2.5 Reply Codes after DATA and the Subsequent <CRLF>.<CRLF>

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When an SMTP server returns a positive completion status (2yz code) after the DATA command is completed with <CRLF>.<CRLF>, it accepts responsibility for delivering the message or retrying/notifying on failure.
actions: accept responsibility for message delivery or retry/notification

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When an SMTP server returns a temporary error status (4yz) code after the DATA command is completed with <CRLF>.<CRLF>, it MUST NOT make a subsequent attempt to deliver that message. The SMTP client retains responsibility for the delivery of that message.
actions: client retains message for possible requeue or return to user

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When an SMTP server returns a permanent error status (5yz) code after the DATA command is completed with <CRLF>.<CRLF>, it MUST NOT make any subsequent attempt to deliver the message. The SMTP client retains responsibility but SHOULD not again attempt delivery to the same server without user review.
actions: client should not retry to same server without user intervention

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: The server MUST NOT make a subsequent attempt to deliver the message after returning a 4yz or 5yz code following DATA <CRLF>.<CRLF>; delivery responsibility remains with the client.
statements.guard_semantics: Determined by reply code class (2yz, 4yz, 5yz) returned after DATA <CRLF>.<CRLF>
